label: preparing
what: A privately funded great-hall jubilee celebration for the mayor's forty years of service, apparently concealed as an eighteen-hundred lighting inspection. Baker explicitly reported 184 jubilee loaves toward a 200-loaf order; Secretary maintains the precisely timed appointment, Builder is attached to the inspection and supplied hay, and Freight gave Innkeeper money. Neighbour appears to help keep the mayor occupied with scheduled tea and knows the hall appointment, though knowing participation in the surprise is less certain.
